notes:
Account snapshot
- Prospect: IronBank Financial (enterprise FS). Strong security posture; running internal GenAI programs under strict governance.
- Target deployment: Private/VPC (AWS) preferred; Dedicated capacity acceptable if VPC isolation + contractual controls are strong.

Primary asks (security / compliance)
- Least-privilege RBAC w/ separation of duties. Quote from call: "We cannot have 'admin means everything' in prod." They want distinct roles for:
  - Security Admin (identity, RBAC policy, audit log export config)
  - Platform/Deployment Operator (capacity, routing policies, model rollouts)
  - Read-only Auditor (view configs + export audit logs; no mutation)
- Provable enforcement: deny-by-default + consistent permission checks across API + Console + control plane. Asked explicitly whether we enforce only at the gateway or also in downstream services.
- Audit logs to SIEM:
  - Must export to Splunk (HEC) and/or Sentinel-compatible pipeline. They can accept S3 + forwarder if schema is stable.
  - Need authz decision context in audit events (who attempted what; allow/deny; reason code; policy version / role binding used).
  - Want examples for both successful and denied attempts (e.g., "deny: missing permission to export audit logs").
- Retention + residency:
  - Asked for retention controls and ability to set retention by log type. Minimum expectations: audit logs retained >= 1 year in-product OR exported continuously; some teams request 7-year retention on their side.
  - US-only residency requirement for POC; do not want silent failover to non-US regions.
- Identity:
  - Okta SAML + group-based role mapping (SCIM preferred but not mandatory for POC).
  - Need documented process for emergency access (break-glass), time-bound, monitored, and reviewed.

Workload
- Use cases: internal knowledge search over policies/procedures; customer support summarization; compliance review assistant (redaction + summarization).
- Throughput: moderate (pilot ~50-150 RPS bursty for embeddings + chat); latency sensitivity for chat; cost sensitivity medium (willing to pay for compliance + predictability).
- Model posture: open to curated open models if we can provide repeatable performance + rollout controls; they care about routing policy change controls.

What we promised / provided so far
- Pointed them at our ongoing RBAC v2 work (permission inventory, role templates, deny-by-default gateway checks, and audit log schema additions). Set expectations that some parts are feature-flagged during rollout.
- Committed to sending:
  - Sample audit log event payloads including authorization decision fields + reason codes (Kevin Osei owner)
  - Role template draft for Security Admin / Deployment Operator / Auditor w/ scopes (org/project/env/cluster) and 'why denied' guidance (Colin + Marcus Lin)
  - Clarification on enforcement model (gateway + service) and caching approach for low latency (Jordan Lee / Amara Diallo consulted)

Open questions from IronBank
- Scoping semantics: They want roles scoped to "environment" (dev/stage/prod) and to specific Private clusters. Asked: "Can an operator manage only prod routing policies but not user management?"
- Console vs API: Need confirmation that Console is fully governed by the same permissions and emits the same audit events.
- Denial UX: They asked for an admin-only way to troubleshoot denies without exposing sensitive policy internals to normal users.

Risks / watch-outs
- They will treat missing audit log fields (authz allow/deny + reason + policy version) as a blocker.
- They will scrutinize break-glass: who can do it, how approvals work, and whether it’s time-bound and alerting to SecOps.
- Any inconsistent 403 behavior or unlogged denies during pilot will likely pause the evaluation.

Internal coordination
- Security Eng: Marcus Lin looped in for questionnaire responses + control mapping.
- Audit export: Kevin Osei engaged for SIEM mapping + sample export records.
- Solutions: Colin O'Donnell driving account; will schedule follow-up with IronBank Security + Platform.

Next actions (internal)
- Provide 2–3 example audit events (allow + deny) showing: subject, action, resource scope, decision, denial_reason_code, policy_version.
- Share draft role templates + recommended separation-of-duties pattern for regulated FS.
- Confirm retention controls story: what’s configurable in-product vs expected to be handled via export/archival; document clearly for their questionnaire.
